about: The same five Strong agents and the same combiner, but the cost cap is 0.50 USD.
how: The estimated price stays under the cap all the way, so the run is not stopped.
learns: A cap above what the run needs changes nothing: it only stops a run that would cost too much. This run costs about 0.15 USD.
watch: The five answers handed to the combiner and the finished combined report. Compare with the twin that was stopped.
